description: Get full details for a specific region/cluster of concepts. Use after graph_context to drill into regions of interest.

detail_level.description: Control verbosity: "titles" = just node names, "brief" = titles + truncated understanding (100 chars), "full" = everything (default)

hide_document_content.description: Hide content from document nodes but show their structure.

include_fields.description: Granular field selection. Overrides detail_level. Example: ["title", "trigger"] for minimal view

region_id.description: The region ID from graph_context output

name: graph_context_region
